Name: Live Appearance Framework - LAF
Author: MasterRoshiHEHE
Description:
[size=4][b]Live Appearance Framework[/b][/size]
[size=2][i]By Master Roshi (kinda)[/i][/size]
[b]What It Does[/b]
LAF updates NPC sprites and portraits [b]in real-time[/b] while you're watching—not just at day start or warps. This lets modders create fluid appearance transitions throughout the day: outfit changes on schedule, location-based looks, idle animations, and custom movement routines that feel alive.
[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[][b]Schedule-Aware Outfits:[/b] Change appearances based on what an NPC is doing today. Works with any schedule mod (Harem Valley, Xtardew, vanilla, etc.). No mod-specific coding needed.
[][b]7 Schedule Queries:[/b] Check if an NPC visits a location, when they leave, how many minutes until departure, their current route, and more. Build outfit logic around schedules that actually change day-to-day.
[][b]Idle Poses:[/b] Custom frame animations for standing NPCs—lying on the beach, sitting at a desk, or dancing in town. Supports shuffled pose stages, intro/outro transitions, and pose-to-outfit pairing.
[][b]Detours:[/b] Queue custom movement routines (walk to the dresser, change clothes, walk back) that fit between schedule stops without making NPCs late.
[][b]Event-Safe:[/b] Events using custom spritesheets won't break—LAF detects event actors and avoids overriding their intended appearance.
[][b]Animation Guards:[/b] Handles frame availability, animation fallbacks, and repair of interrupted animations automatically.
[/list][b]For Modders[/b]
Define appearance entries in Content Patcher with LAF's Game State Queries (GSQs):
[list]
[][b]MasterRoshiHehe.LiveAppearanceFramework_SCHEDULE_VISITS[/b] Haley Beach
[][b]MasterRoshiHehe.LiveAppearanceFramework_SCHEDULE_MINUTES_BEFORE_LEAVING[/b] Beach 20
[][b]MasterRoshiHehe.LiveAppearanceFramework_NPC_IN_POSE[/b] Haley BeachTowel
[]...and 4 more schedule queries for precise control.
[/list]LAF re-checks conditions on clock ticks, warps, schedule changes, dialogues, and pose transitions—so your outfits stay synced with gameplay.
[b]Works With[/b]
Optional GMCM for settings. Console commands (laf_watch, laf_why, laf_schedule) for debugging. Integrates with Animated Portrait Framework for portraits, Positional Audio for sound cues on pose changes, and any schedule-modifying mod.
[b]Install[/b]
Drop in your SMAPI mods folder. Requires SMAPI 4.5.2+.
